concepts.name: Serving size
concepts.source_span: The numbers on a label are given for one serving, or for a fixed amount such as 100 grams. - A pack often contains more than one serving, so eating the whole pack means multiplying the numbers. - Always check the serving size and the number of servings per pack before comparing products.

questions.stem: A pack contains 3 servings and one serving has 200 kcal. How many kcal are in the whole pack?
What should you check before comparing two products?
options: The serving size and servings per pack

questions.stem: The numbers on a label are usually given for:
options: One serving or a fixed amount such as 100 grams

questions.stem: Why can the whole pack have more calories than the main numbers suggest?
options: The pack may hold more than one serving
The numbers are for the packaging

questions.stem: Crisps A: 150 kcal per 30 g serving. Crisps B: 520 kcal per 100 g. Which has more energy per gram?
options: You can't tell from the labels

questions.stem: Two snacks both say '120 kcal per serving'. Why might one give you far more energy when you finish the pack?
options: kcal are measured differently by each brand
Their serving sizes and servings per pack can differ

questions.stem: A 3-serving pack lists 4 g of sugar per serving. You eat two-thirds of the pack. How much sugar is that?
How are calories written on a label?
What is another unit of energy on labels?
About how many kilojoules equal one kilocalorie?
What do calories tell you?
options: How much energy the food gives you

questions.stem: A drink has 840 kJ. About how many kcal is that?
An apple and a biscuit have the same number of calories. What does that tell you?
options: Only that they give the same energy, not which is healthier

questions.stem: One snack lists 600 kJ, another 120 kcal. Which gives more energy?

concepts.name: Macronutrients
concepts.source_span: Fat gives 9 kcal per gram, more than double the other two.

questions.stem: Which macronutrient gives 9 kcal per gram?
How much energy does protein give per gram?
How much energy do carbohydrates give per gram?
Which are the three macronutrients?
A snack has 10 g of carbohydrate and 5 g of protein. How many kcal do these give?
Which gives more energy: 10 g of fat or 20 g of protein?
Why can a small amount of oily food be high in calories?
options: Fat gives more than twice the energy per gram of carbohydrate or protein

concepts.name: Sugars
concepts.source_span: Added sugars are sugars put in during making, such as in biscuits and soft drinks.

questions.stem: What are added sugars?
options: Sugars put in during making, such as in biscuits and soft drinks

questions.stem: Which sugars occur naturally?
What do many health guidelines advise about added sugars?
Total sugars on a label include:
A plain yoghurt shows 5 g of total sugars and 0 g of added sugars. What does that tell you?
options: Sugar was added while making it

questions.stem: A drink lists 20 g of total sugars, of which 12 g are added. How much occurs naturally?
Which label suggests a breakfast cereal has a lot of added sugar?
options: It shows 3 percent of the daily value of sugar

concepts.name: Sodium and salt
concepts.source_span: To convert sodium to salt, multiply the sodium amount by 2.5.

questions.stem: How do you convert sodium to salt?
About what share of salt is sodium?
A label shows 400 mg of sodium. About how much salt is that?
What can large amounts of sodium affect?
A label shows 0.6 g of sodium. About how much salt is that?
Which contains more sodium: 1 g of salt or 1 g of pure sodium?
A label lists 2.5 g of salt. About how much sodium is that?

concepts.name: Ingredients and daily value
concepts.source_span: Ingredients are listed in order of weight, with the heaviest ingredient first.

questions.stem: In what order are ingredients listed?
If sugar is near the top of the ingredients list, the food:
How is a percent daily value of 20 percent or more described?
How is a percent daily value of 5 percent or less described?
A cereal lists oats, sugar and salt, in that order. Which is present in the largest amount by weight?
Cereal A gives 4 percent of the daily value of fibre per serving; cereal B gives 22 percent. Which is the high-fibre choice?
A cereal gives 10 percent of the daily value of fibre per serving. You eat two servings. How is your fibre from it described?
